checks.name: The built application starts a never-configured profile on the runtime and the Postgres it carries, with only system folders on the PATH
The application, its Erlang and its Postgres run under the hardened runtime, and the terminal starts a shell
The application carries no Claude Code or Codex of its own and is under 650 MB
New page in the built application is a Paper on the carried runtime; typed and saved
After a quit and a restart of the application the note reads the same; nothing was left running in between

limits: One Mac, one run. The application was built on this machine from the working tree named in `source`, signed ad hoc, not notarized, and started from its build folder, not installed, under a name of its own so its keychain item is its own. It is started with --profiles; an ordinary launch still opens the single legacy library. No Mac without developer tools has run it.
